info.name: Route Fuel Planner API
info.description: Demonstrates a US route and the recommended fuel stops. The Visualize tab draws the GeoJSON route with numbered stop markers.

request.description: Returns route GeoJSON, selected fuel stops, and the trip fuel-spend estimate.

exec: pm.test('Request completed successfully', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const result = pm.response.json();
if (pm.response.code === 200 && result.route && result.route.geometry && result.route.geometry.coordinates) {
const route = result.route.geometry.coordinates;
const stops = result.fuel_stops || [];
const allPoints = route.concat(stops.map(s => [s.coordinates.longitude, s.coordinates.latitude]));
const meanLat = allPoints.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p[1], 0) / allPoints.length;
const projected = allPoints.map(p => [p[0] * Math.cos(meanLat * Math.PI / 180), p[1]]);
const xs = projected.map(p => p[0]), ys = projected.map(p => p[1]);
const minX = Math.min(...xs), maxX = Math.max(...xs), minY = Math.min(...ys), maxY = Math.max(...ys);
const width = 960, height = 500, pad = 36;
const sx = (width - 2 * pad) / Math.max(maxX - minX, 1e-8), sy = (height - 2 * pad) / Math.max(maxY - minY, 1e-8);
const scale = Math.min(sx, sy);
const drawWidth = (maxX - minX) * scale, drawHeight = (maxY - minY) * scale;
const left = (width - drawWidth) / 2, top = (height - drawHeight) / 2;
const xy = p => [left + (p[0] - minX) * scale, height - top - (p[1] - minY) * scale];
const path = route.map((p, i) => { const q = xy([p[0] * Math.cos(meanLat * Math.PI / 180), p[1]]); return (i ? 'L' : 'M') + q[0].toFixed(1) + ' ' + q[1].toFixed(1); }).join(' ');

const markers = stops.map((s, i) => { const q = xy([s.coordinates.longitude * Math.cos(meanLat * Math.PI / 180), s.coordinates.latitude]); return '<g><circle cx="' + q[0].toFixed(1) + '" cy="' + q[1].toFixed(1) + '" r="12" fill="#e86b2f" stroke="white" stroke-width="3"/><text x="' + q[0].toFixed(1) + '" y="' + (q[1] + 4).toFixed(1) + '" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="11" font-weight="bold">' + (i + 1) + '</text></g>'; }).join('');

const svg = '<svg viewBox="0 0 ' + width + ' ' + height + '" role="img" aria-label="Route and recommended fuel stops"><rect width="100%" height="100%" rx="14" fill="#f3f6f8"/><path d="' + path + '" fill="none" stroke="#246b8e" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>' + markers + '</svg>';

pm.visualizer.set('

Driving route and recommended fuel stops

{{{svg}}}

Blue line: route · Numbered orange markers: fuel stops · Coordinates are approximate city/town centers.

', { svg: svg });
} else {

pm.visualizer.set('
{{body}}
', { body: JSON.stringify(result, null, 2) });
